goal.text: The user is working through a floor stretching session and wants the assistant to keep a running log so it can read the whole sequence back at the end.

turns.text: Keep a log of this session for me, would you?

trigger.detail: user opens the session while lying on the floor

expected_answer.text: Happy to. I'll track each pose and how long you hold it, and read the list back when you're done.

turns.text: And right now — which arm have I got stretched out behind me?

trigger.detail: the turn-onto-the-side movement finishes and the stretch settles

expected_answer.text: Your left one is stretched back along the floor; your right arm is bent in front of your chest.

turns.text: Anything but carpet in view down here?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the storage unit and settles on the open room

expected_answer.text: The edge of a doorway is off to one side, and a stretch of plain wall; nothing else is really in frame.

turns.text: Actually — how long have I been down here now?

trigger.detail: user cuts in mid-answer to check the clock on the session

expected_answer.text: A little over half a minute of floor work so far, counting from when you first lay down.

turns.text: Did I come straight up, or not?

trigger.detail: the lying sequence ends and the wearer is up on knees and hands

expected_answer.text: Straight up. You pushed off the floor from lying flat and settled onto your knees with both hands planted.

turns.text: Right, got it — don't bother narrating unless I ask.

trigger.detail: user talks over the reply to set ground rules

expected_answer.text: Understood. I'll stay quiet and keep logging in the background until you ask.

turns.text: Anyway — what did I shift into after the crawling bit?

trigger.detail: the hands-forward crawl ends and a new shape is held

expected_answer.text: You rolled through cat-cow a few times, then folded down into child's pose with your arms out front.

turns.text: Did I just glance up at something?

trigger.detail: the wearer lifts out of the fold and lowers back into it

expected_answer.text: Yes, you lifted your chest for a second to check the laptop in front of you, then lowered back down.

turns.text: Mm-hm — actually, was that the first time I've done that?

trigger.detail: a backchannel over the reply turns into a question

expected_answer.text: Yes, first look up since you went down; before that your eyes stayed on the carpet the whole way through.

turns.text: And now that's twice, isn't it?

trigger.detail: a second look up and back down to the floor completes

expected_answer.text: Twice, yes. Same move both times: lift, check the screen, settle back down into the fold.

turns.text: How did I get out of that?

trigger.detail: the wearer comes up, side-sits, and opens into a seated shape

expected_answer.text: You lifted up, turned to your left, side-sat for a moment, then brought both feet together in front of you.

turns.text: Hold on — how long was I folded up like that?

trigger.detail: user cuts into the reply to pin down the duration

expected_answer.text: Roughly thirty-five seconds in that fold, from just before the one-minute mark until you sat up a moment ago.

turns.text: Which leg went out first just then?

trigger.detail: the seated open-leg shape ends and a forward reach begins

expected_answer.text: The left. You stretched it forward while your right stayed folded in, then reached for that foot with both hands.

turns.text: And have I done that side already, or is this the first?

trigger.detail: user talks over the reply to check symmetry of the routine

expected_answer.text: First time on that one. Everything before this was symmetrical, so you've got the mirror of it still to do.

turns.text: That's the switch done then — give me the whole run-through.

trigger.detail: the wearer swaps legs and settles into the mirrored reach

expected_answer.text: Floor stretches, then knees and cat-cow, child's pose with two laptop checks, cobbler's sit, and toe touches on each leg.
